notes.title: Mini Patch Aug 31
notes.notes:
I changed the "camera help." No more indication at the bottom of the world screen.

Instead, I added 3 gifs in Settings, to show how keys +/=/-/arrows control camera.

notes.title: 3rd Mini Patch - Aug 30
notes.notes: NOW the camera zoom/unzoom is fixed ^^ phew

notes.title: 2nd Mini Patch - Aug 30
notes.notes:
Camera zoom/unzoom didn't work properly.

My bad. This was coded in Qwerty & not Unicode - so the right keys didn't work for the zoom/unzoom.

This is fixed. Now pressing + (ou just =) will zoom. And - to unzoom.

notes.title: Mini Patch Aug 30
notes.notes:
Changed the path where we export screenshots.

It used be buried in systems folders.

Now it's in your Pictures folder, with a sub-folder Retro Meadow, and a sub-folder for each world.

notes.title: 2nd Mini Patch Aug 28
notes.notes:
Fixed sound settings:
- if you muted some audio, when reloading the game, this audio wouldn't be mute.
- the two dark waters had no sfx.

This is now fixed.

notes.title: Mini patch Aug 28
notes.notes:
Added Ana Laura dos Passos to the credits.
She's the artist who made all the Steam art - capsules + title logos.

notes.title: 2nd mini-patch Aug 27
notes.notes:
Remove vision button in bottom-left.

This was here before to take clean screenshots. But it's useless after I added the screenshot button.

I saw a streamer getting confused with it & leaving the game after the UI disappeared. So it's just best to remove it.

notes.title: Mini patch Aug 27
notes.notes:
The key '+' is camera zoom. You don't need to press 'Shift' to use it.

But I forgot to add the case where you actually press '+' (and not '=') with 'Shift.'

This first patch fixes it. Now, the camera zoom works when you press 'Shift' too.
